entries.name: osascript
entries.note: osascript runs scripts in the BifrOSt scripting language (springboard/core/src/script). A tell app block sends each command to the running app as an AppEvent, resolved through the app's dictionary in its manifest ([[script.command]] and [[script.class]]).
